reviews.text: Matt and Gabi did an outstanding job painting at our house. They’re experienced painters with excellent attention to detail. They were very organized and good communicators throughout the work. Their clean up was immaculate. Our rooms look transformed. I would 100% recommend them.

Matt did a great job painting our daughter’s nursery! Super friendly, left the room clean, and reasonably priced. He suggested a zero-VOC paint that was safe for baby, and expertly worked around angles with the sloped ceiling.
We have hired Tudor Revival over a number of years, most recently to repair and paint ceilings, doors and trim. All the work was done meticulously to beautifully match the existing paint and decor.
